# AMPLab Q3 — Text Search

```{tags} reference, query-template, amplab
```

> [AMPLab](../../amplab.md) benchmark · [all AMPLab queries](index.md)

Text search on searchWord with HAVING on visit_count

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT sourceIP, COUNT(*) AS visit_count, SUM(adRevenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(duration) AS avg_duration FROM uservisits WHERE visitDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-03' AND searchWord LIKE '%database%' GROUP BY sourceIP HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def q3_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """Q3: Text search on uservisits with HAVING on visit_count."""
    params = get_parameters("Q3")
    start_date = params.get("start_date", date(2000, 1, 1))
    end_date = params.get("end_date", date(2000, 1, 3))
    search_term = params.get("search_term", "database")
    min_visits = params.get("min_visits", 10)
    limit_rows = params.get("limit_rows", 100)

    uservisits = ctx.get_table("uservisits")
    col = ctx.col
    lit = ctx.lit

    return (
        uservisits.filter(
            (col("visitDate").cast_date() >= lit(start_date))
            & (col("visitDate").cast_date() <= lit(end_date))
            & (col("searchWord").str.contains(search_term))
        )
        .group_by("sourceIP")
        .agg(
            col("sourceIP").count().alias("visit_count"),
            col("adRevenue").sum().alias("total_revenue"),
            col("duration").mean().alias("avg_duration"),
        )
        .filter(col("visit_count") > lit(min_visits))
        .sort("total_revenue", descending=True)
        .limit(limit_rows)
    )
```
